verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.he: עַד־אָ֣נָה יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד־אָ֓נָה ׀ תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת־פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.ar: إِلَى مَتَى يَارَبُّ تَنْسَانِي كُلَّ ٱلنِّسْيَانِ؟ إِلَى مَتَى تَحْجُبُ وَجْهَكَ عَنِّي؟
verses.en: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou forget me for ever? How long wilt Thou hide Thy face from me?
verses.kjv: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

verses.he: עַד־אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצֹ֡ות בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָגֹ֣ון בִּלְבָבִ֣י יֹומָ֑ם עַד־אָ֓נָה ׀ יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃
verses.ar: إِلَى مَتَى أَجْعَلُ هُمُومًا فِي نَفْسِي وَحُزْنًا فِي قَلْبِي كُلَّ يَوْمٍ؟ إِلَى مَتَى يَرْتَفِعُ عَدُوِّي عَلَيَّ؟
verses.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart by day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.kjv: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, [having] sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.web: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

verses.he: הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן־אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.ar: ٱنْظُرْ وَٱسْتَجِبْ لِي يَارَبُّ إِلَهِي. أَنِرْ عَيْنَيَّ لِئَلَّا أَنَامَ نَوْمَ ٱلْمَوْتِ،
verses.en: Behold Thou, and answer me, O LORD my God; lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.kjv: Consider [and] hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;
verses.web: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

verses.he: פֶּן־יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣י יְכָלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמֹּֽוט׃
verses.ar: لِئَلَّا يَقُولَ عَدُوِّي: «قَدْ قَوِيتُ عَلَيْهِ». لِئَلَّا يَهْتِفَ مُضَايِقِيَّ بِأَنِّي تَزَعْزَعْتُ.
verses.en: Lest mine enemy say: 'I have prevailed against him'; lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.
verses.kjv: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; [and] those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.web: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

verses.he: וַאֲנִ֤י ׀ בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּֽישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַיהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י גָמַ֣ל עָלָֽי׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَعَلَى رَحْمَتِكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ. يَبْتَهِجُ قَلْبِي بِخَلَاصِكَ. أُغَنِّي لِلرَّبِّ لِأَنَّهُ أَحْسَنَ إِلَيَّ.
verses.en: But as for me, in Thy mercy do I trust; my heart shall rejoice in Thy salvation. I will sing unto the LORD, because He hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.kjv: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation. I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.web: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation. I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
